msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 4:3, referencia la-plateria-del-sur-31.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury campaign still life of a red coral cross pendant with gold caps on a fine gold chain from the reference, arranged on pale travertine stone with soft late-afternoon sunlight and delicate shadows, the piece filling the centre-right of the frame, warm ivory tones, macro-sharp detail. One single continuous photograph. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia la-plateria-del-sur-12.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a red enamel cross pendant with a gold frame on a fine gold chain from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia la-plateria-del-sur-22.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of an ornate turquoise and gold cross pendant on a fine gold chain from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia la-plateria-del-sur-10.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of red coral bead hoop earrings from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia la-plateria-del-sur-23.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a long red drop earring with a gold bow and a red cabochon from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight.
